# SuperCLI repository

> Community-maintained CLI discovery and GitHub repository rankings. Static Vite + TypeScript site. Contributions are reviewed locally and merged manually.

- Website: https://supercli.site/
- Repository: https://github.com/webkubor/supercli
- Agent instructions: ./AGENTS.md
- Quick start and local commands: ./README.md
- Contribution and review: ./CONTRIBUTING.md and ./docs/REVIEW.md
- Canonical catalog: ./data/catalog.json
- Repository-bound metrics: ./data/metrics.json
- Input contracts: ./data/catalog.schema.json and ./data/metrics.schema.json
- Shared validation: ./scripts/validation.mjs
- Brand asset provenance: ./docs/ICONS.md
- Security reporting: ./SECURITY.md
- Deployment: ./docs/DEPLOYMENT.md

Use pnpm build for local verification. Do not infer CLI user counts from repository stars. Do not commit credentials or enable automatic PR approval/merge.
